conclusions.title: Modernisation is real; the estate baseline is unresolved
conclusions.statement: The company describes operating-estate change on two pages, but their cloud/data-centre measures cannot be merged into a comparable current baseline.
missing_evidence: Effective dates, application populations, data-centre denominator and retirement versus migration definition
conclusions.change_from_v2: V2 had a missing mapped operating-model screen; v3 supplies specific estate observations and exposes a scope/time tension instead of choosing the larger figure.

conclusions.title: Existing platform and controls constrain a greenfield assumption
conclusions.statement: Envoy is already described with Google Cloud and built-in controls. Missing control effectiveness or integration demand needs evidence, rather than assuming no platform exists.
missing_evidence: Effectiveness, assurance, contract boundaries and residual workflow issues
conclusions.change_from_v2: Adds exact platform/control passages and an explicitly bounded relationship review; it does not create a new supplier contract or need.

conclusions.title: Investment plans are not measured net benefits
conclusions.statement: The secondary report repeats a management investment intention; its separate publisher does not independently establish the economic outcome of Envoy or Group-wide AI.
missing_evidence: Independent outcomes, realised versus target benefits, attributable costs and adoption
conclusions.change_from_v2: New source-family diversity is useful context, but independent outcome corroboration remains zero.

contradictions.status: Unresolved scope/time tension, not proven same-period contradiction
contradictions.treatment: Retain both measures; do not average, select the newest-looking page or silently supersede. Obtain dated comparable estate definitions.
contradictions.effect: No single current cloud/data-centre baseline is authorised.

source_limitations.status: Direct Reuters retrieval unavailable; index is not original content

follow_up_tasks.question: Reconcile cloud and data-centre measures using dated estate populations, denominators and migration/retirement definitions.
follow_up_tasks.reason: Two attributable pages differ; a larger figure is not automatically the current baseline.

follow_up_tasks.question: Obtain workload adoption, attributable operating costs and net-benefit baselines; test effects against counterfactuals and existing controls.
follow_up_tasks.reason: Envoy capability and controls are described; achieved incremental economics remain unverified.

follow_up_tasks.question: Verify programme allocation, accountable ownership, current contract boundaries and permitted sourcing routes before treating investment plans as external spend.
follow_up_tasks.reason: The secondary article reports management intent, not supplier eligibility or a contract.
